capabilities: Consolidate all footnote definitions into one place
Sort footnote definitions by order of appearance
Run via command palette or hotkey
extras: README documents caveats: footnotes inside code blocks are parsed instead of ignored, and all definitions are moved to where the first definition was found.
problem: Footnote definitions scattered through a note and numbered out of order are hard to follow and maintain.
summary: Command-based footnote tidier that consolidates footnote definitions into one place and re-indexes numbered footnotes in order of appearance.
